body: The `suggestedFilename` is not set from WebDriver BiDi, as is defined by the [get the suggested filename](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/links.html#getting-the-suggested-filename) algorithm. It is passed as an argument to [WebDriver BiDi download will begin](https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-download-will-begin) to be used in the [browsingContext.downloadWillBegin](https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#cddl-type-browsingcontextdownloadwillbegin) WebDriver BiDi event. WebDriver BiDi can influence only [`allowed` and `destinationFolder `](https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#download-behavior-struct).

body:
The most common example is when the browsers opens a file directly instead of saving it, e.g. when the user clicks a link to a PDF. The browser might open it directly in a new tab. To do this, the browser is not required to use the suggested filename, as it saves the file to a temporary cache folder first. When the user asks to save that file later, then the `suggestedFilename` will be used.

In this case "save response for later use" means "download the file to a temp path and show it's content to user, providing a way to the user to save the file to downloads".
